novelty_search.nearest_result: H1/H4 transport is/was A state through contextualized moment/determiner sources but exceed the P selectivity bar on an insertion paraphrase whose token positions are unaligned.
novelty_search.new_question: Does H1/H4 remain selective on a one-token, position-aligned same-tense moment-to-instant paraphrase, and is any residual movement localized to that changed carrier noun?

population: Sixteen new P rows over the matched-v2 occupations. Base 'At this/that moment the X' and donor 'At this/that instant the X' have identical is/was answers, equal token length, and exactly one aligned changed token.

arms.identity_full_pair: Replace complete base H1/H4 vectors with exact cached base vectors.
arms.donor_full_pair_manual: Replace complete base H1/H4 with donor vectors through the manual attention path.
arms.donor_full_pair_native_hook: Same donor replacement through the trusted producer head hook.
arms.changed_noun_term: Replace only the exact moment/instant source term.
arms.determiner_term: Replace only the following determiner source term.
arms.self_term: Replace only the final occupation source term.

operator.no_rescue: No phrase, token, source, head, threshold, or bar change after execution.

bars.capability: Base and donor accuracy >=0.85 separately in both temporal directions.
bars.instrument: Manual/native logits and H1/H4 source reconstruction <=1e-4; identity and manual-full versus trusted-hook errors <=1e-5; exact finite coverage.
bars.selectivity: Donor full-pair mean normalized absolute effect <=0.20 target scales.
bars.source: If full-pair effect >=0.02, changed-noun term retains >=0.50 of it; otherwise the nuisance is below the localization floor. Determiner and self effects are each <= changed-noun effect.
bars.price: Ten forwards/160 examples, six intervention arms, zero fit/grid/root/backward/update.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_instru: All hashes, alignment, capability, manual/native/source reconstruction, identity, route agreement, finiteness, and coverage pass.
predictions.pred_b_alignment_preserving_P_selectivit: Full H1/H4 aligned-P effect is <=0.20 target scales.
predictions.pred_c_changed_carrier_source_explains_r: Changed noun retains >=0.50 of a meaningful full effect, or full effect is below 0.02.
predictions.pred_d_changed_source_specificity: Determiner and self effects do not exceed the changed-noun effect.
predictions.pred_e_exact_zero_fit_price: Exactly ten forwards/160 examples and no fitting or search.

terminal.screen: A-E pass: cross-task H1/H4 selectivity holds under aligned P, and residual surface movement is source-localized or negligible.
terminal.null: Instrument passes but selectivity or source predictions miss; retain the P nuisance boundary.
terminal.invalid: Authority, alignment, capability, instrument, finiteness, coverage, or price fails.
